title: Cebu City police summons minors in viral Barangay Tejero riot video

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The Waterfront Police Station of the Cebu City Police Office (CCPO) summoned a group of minors who were allegedly involved in a riot in Barangay Tejero, Cebu City, on Saturday evening, Sept. 19, 2026. A video of the incident went viral on social media. It showed two groups who threw glass bottles at one another at an intersection. Police summoned the minors before noon on Monday, September 21. They identified those involved by visiting the barangay and working with Barangay Captain Harold Seño and other officials, the Waterfront Police Station said in its own Facebook post.
